claims.claimValue: external AI tools restricted to non-sensitive, non-confidential research content

evidence.evidenceSnippet: Commercial generative AI platforms like ChatGPT, Bing and others store data externally. To minimise risk, use only non-sensitive, non-confidential content that is suitable for public or external use.

coursework.en: Your final submitted assessment must be your own work, creation and analysis. Deakin GEM should not generate or submit assessment content.
coursework.zh: 最终提交的考核须为你本人的工作、创作与分析；不应使用 Deakin GEM 生成或提交考核内容。
coursework.meaningEn: These are source-specific assessment and GEM statements; check the unit’s current instructions. The old assessment URL is broken and has not been treated as current policy.
coursework.meaningZh: 分别保留考核指引及 GEM 的原有范围，请查当前课程说明；旧考核链接失效，未将其当作现行政策。

exams.en: An exam-specific permission rule was not established. Check the actual exam and unit instructions.
exams.zh: 尚未核实考试专用许可规则，请查实际考试及课程说明。
exams.meaningEn: General assessment and tool guidance cannot grant an exam permission.
exams.meaningZh: 一般考核及工具指引不能授予考试许可。

disclosure.en: The acknowledgement page says that in all cases GenAI use must be acknowledged as outlined there; the excerpt explicitly names the tool.
disclosure.zh: 披露页面明确要求在所有情况下按其说明承认生成式 AI 使用；现有节选明确列出工具名称。
disclosure.meaningEn: The full acknowledgement list, exceptions and citation examples were not captured here. Reopen the complete official page before treating this as a submission checklist.
disclosure.meaningZh: 完整披露项目、例外及引用示例尚未收齐，不可将本节选当作完整提交清单；应核对官方原页。

privacy_data.en: Research guidance warns that information entered into AI may be retained, reused or accessed beyond your control.
privacy_data.zh: 研究指引警示：输入 AI 的信息可能被保留、再利用，或在你控制范围之外被访问。
privacy_data.meaningEn: Research guidance; a complete data classification and tool-specific protection assessment remains missing.
privacy_data.meaningZh: 适用于研究指引；完整数据分类及各工具保护机制仍待核实。

approved_tools.en: Deakin GEM is free and available to all students, with an explicit restriction against generating or submitting assessment content. The learning directory separately lists Copilot for web via DeakinEdge and a Microsoft account.
approved_tools.zh: Deakin GEM 免费向全体学生开放，但明确不应生成或提交考核内容；学习目录另列出经 DeakinEdge 和 Microsoft 账户使用的网页版 Copilot。
approved_tools.meaningEn: GEM and Copilot for web are separate access modes. This is not evidence that every student has a paid Microsoft 365 Copilot licence or unrestricted assessment permission.
approved_tools.meaningZh: GEM 与网页版 Copilot 须区分；这不证明每位学生拥有付费 Microsoft 365 Copilot 许可或无限制考核使用权。

research_publication.en: For HDR thesis text, GenAI use is limited to copyediting and proofreading. Do not use GenAI to assess peer-review material such as grants, manuscripts, HDR theses or ethics applications.
research_publication.zh: HDR 学位论文文本仅可用生成式 AI 做文字编辑及校对；不得用其评估基金、稿件、HDR 论文或伦理申请等同行评审材料。
research_publication.meaningEn: Research/HDR guidance; this is not a general coursework permission. Full original documents were blocked during independent retrieval.
research_publication.meaningZh: 适用于科研及 HDR 指引，不是一般课程作业许可；本次独立抓取完整原件受阻。

academic_integrity.en: The procedure gives five working days from receipt of an allegation. Acceptance of a late response up to ten working days after it was sent is discretionary; these are different clocks.
academic_integrity.zh: 程序规定收到指控后五个工作日内回应；发出指控后最多十个工作日的迟交接纳由委员会酌情决定，两者起算点不同。
academic_integrity.meaningEn: The seven-day honest-mistake resubmission excerpt is not an entitlement for every case. Eligibility, exam exclusions, grade conditions and the full appeal process remain gaps.
academic_integrity.meaningZh: 诚实错误的七天重交节选不适用于所有案件；资格、考试例外、成绩条件和完整申诉程序仍待核实。

teaching_guidance.en: The assessment guidance requires submitted work to remain the student’s own; the collected material does not establish a complete staff AI-grading policy.
teaching_guidance.zh: 考核指引要求提交物仍为学生本人工作；现有材料不足以建立完整的教师 AI 评分政策。
teaching_guidance.meaningEn: Do not derive staff permission to upload or grade student work from a student-tool directory.
teaching_guidance.meaningZh: 不得从学生工具目录推导教师上传或评分学生作品的许可。

security_procurement.en: A GenAI Steering Group established in 2023 is identified, but its existence does not establish a current procurement approval or data-security workflow.
security_procurement.zh: 来源提及 2023 年成立的生成式 AI 指导小组，但这不能证明现行采购批准或数据安全流程。
security_procurement.meaningEn: Governance context only; full security, vendor and procurement requirements remain unverified.
security_procurement.meaningZh: 仅为治理背景；完整安全、供应商及采购要求仍未核实。

scope.en: Use the source-specific audience, assessment and publication limits below. Institution-wide policy review remains PARTIAL.
scope.zh: 请按下列来源的对象、考核及发表范围使用信息，整校政策审核仍为 PARTIAL。

do.en: Acknowledge GenAI use according to the official acknowledgement guidance.
do.zh: 按官方披露指引承认生成式 AI 使用。

dont.en: Do not use GenAI to assess peer-review material.
dont.zh: 不得用生成式 AI 评估同行评审材料。
